name: Caer Nefenhir

attributes.attribute: name means the castle of high heaven
named in the story of Kulhwch and Olwen

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Caer Nefenhir is a Welsh mythological site. The name means the castle of high heaven. It lies in the Otherworld. The site appears in several old texts. The texts include the story of Kulhwch and Olwen.

okr.objective: Caer Nefenhir is the castle of high heaven in Welsh myth.
key_results: Its name means the castle of high heaven.
Several old texts name it, including the tale of Kulhwch and Olwen.
